title: Grid, Coordinates, Scale & Projection Engine
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-25 America/Chicago freshly verified exact AIOC/application heads, re-read completed MAI-01/MAI-02 evidence plus MIB-11/D18 World and D29 authoring-provenance boundaries, and resolved the bounded MAI-03 projection contract before implementation.
objective: Implement deterministic provider-neutral grid, coordinate, scale and projection mechanics over the completed MAI-02 schema without creating World/combat identity, connectivity/autotile semantics, runtime geometry ownership, importer/resolver/workbench/runtime integration or durable persistence changes.

resolved_contract.round_trip_rule: Supported projection pairs must be deterministic and reversible within an explicit numeric tolerance; unknown/invalid projection metadata returns explicit findings rather than inferred semantics.
resolved_contract.scale_rule: Scale is presentation metadata only. pixels-per-unit and unit labels may be converted deterministically but never create canonical World distance, location, topology or combat identity.
resolved_contract.mai02_reuse: Consume MAI-02 dimensions, transforms, anchors, grid descriptors and owner/source/provenance records; do not redefine asset identity or weaken MAI-01/02 boundaries.

acceptance_profile.provider_neutral_projection: No Tiled, LDtk, Foundry or other vendor/editor coordinate model becomes canonical.
acceptance_profile.grid_support: Deterministic square, gridless, flat/point hex, isometric and staggered projection descriptors with explicit origin/cell/axis metadata.
acceptance_profile.coordinate_conversion: Pure read-only conversion among supported MAI-03 coordinate spaces, including reversible layer/placeable transforms derived from MAI-02 descriptors.
acceptance_profile.scale: Explicit finite positive pixels-per-unit conversion with unit labels/reference only; no World-distance authority.
acceptance_profile.owner_boundaries: Coordinates, transforms, scale and projections remain presentation data; D18/MIB-11 World and existing Scene/Combat/Visibility owners remain authoritative.
acceptance_profile.predecessor_boundaries: Preserve MAI-01 license/incomplete-pack rules and MAI-02 provenance, unsupported-metadata and semantic-vs-art separation.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused MAI-03 projection verifier and client regression plus MAI-02 predecessor, MAI-01 survey and MIB-11 World-owner regressions, then exact-head Repository Health and governed self-hosted Linux/Windows deterministic comparison before merge.

nonauthorization: World/location/topology/navigation or combat identity inferred from coordinates or art
migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Implement only the bounded MAI-03 projection engine/evidence package on integration/mai-03-grid-coordinates-scale-projection-engine, validate exact head, merge only after required gates pass, then close MAI-03 completed_verified and select MAI-04 without starting it.
